title: Modpack Now Loading
description: The best modpack for Dungeon Now Loading
body:
This is a Fan Made modpack for the mod Dungeon Now Loading. 

This modpack includes Dungeon Now Loading (Of course) and other QoL mods like Iris, Xaero's Minimap and World Map, Better F3 and 3D Skin layers, with more to be added.

This modpack also includes a custom UI made by me.
